note: S14b.1 the DEPTH-0 anti-regression lock (sibling to cells_rec_flat_eq). A ZERO-promotion store (promotions absent → defaults []) round-trips through derive_nested UNCHANGED: derive_nested's first arm is `if (.promotions//[]|length)==0 then $arr` — it returns the input verbatim, authoring NO .nested key. So `eq` (derive_nested(flat)==flat) AND `cells_eq` (cells_rec(derive_nested(flat))==cells_md(flat.segments)) both hold — the S11 base case is preserved by construction. A flat bag [v@600] over a 1000x1000 display gives a 2-cell partition; the derived view is byte-identical to the flat one (no relocation fires absent a promotion). This is why arrangement-bridge/golden-equiv/store-roundtrip stay green: they never author a promotion, so derive_nested is never anything but identity on their stores.
